mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_exception WHERE resolution_status IN ('OPEN', 'ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'ESCALATED') AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY CASE exception_level WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, create_time ASC

SELECT * FROM settlement_exception WHERE ( exception_level = 'CRITICAL' OR (exception_level = 'HIGH' AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR)) OR (exception_level = 'MEDIUM' AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) ) AND resolution_status IN ('OPEN', 'ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY CASE exception_level WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, create_time ASC

SELECT * FROM settlement_exception WHERE resolution_status IN ('OPEN', 'ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hoursThreshold} HOUR) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT * FROM settlement_exception WHERE resolution_status IN ('OPEN', 'ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND ( (exception_level = 'MEDIUM' AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) OR (exception_level = 'HIGH' AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) OR (exception_level = 'CRITICAL' AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR)) ) AND (escalation_time IS NULL OR escalation_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 4 HOUR)) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY CASE exception_level WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_exception SET assigned_user = #{assignedUser}, assigned_time = NOW(), resolution_status = 'ASSIGNED', update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE exception_id = #{exceptionId}

UPDATE settlement_exception SET escalation_level = #{escalationLevel}, escalation_time = NOW(), exception_level = #{newExceptionLevel}, resolution_status = 'ESCALATED', update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE exception_id = #{exceptionId}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN exception_level = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as criticalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN exception_level = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as highCount, SUM(CASE WHEN resolution_status = 'RESOLVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as resolvedCount FROM settlement_exception WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date
